evidence:
Verdict is by reasoning through the rubric as the skill's check 39 prescribes ('reason through a blank page, a static mock, a seed copy, a keyword-stuffed page, and a submission that refuses every action'); it is NOT a measured result. raw-evidence-index.json scope states 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and target/Oracle scores are absent', so no weak-app run exists and risk stays true.

SCORING PATH (tests/tools/score.py:40-48, byte-identical to template; tests/scoring.toml:1-11): gates_passed needs render>0 and constraints>0; otherwise all scored dimensions are 0 and reward 0. floors_passed needs functional>0.05; otherwise reward 0.0 regardless of polish/visual. test.sh:213-222 stops after a gate failure and never runs the scored suite.

FLOOR CASES:
1. Blank page / unavailable / no server.js: test.sh:68-70 and 123-125 leave the zero reward; otherwise render gate fails ('reveals a substantive recruiting workspace with usable navigation', gates/render/judge.toml:23). Reward 0.
2. Static mock / static login picture / health-only: render criterion says 'A static login/workspace picture or only a health response is insufficient' and needs wrong-password rejection plus a real sign-in. A mock that fakes sign-in client-side still meets the constraints gate (gates/constraints/judge.toml:23-25): create a requisition AND a PENDING offer through the UI, then retrieve both in a new independent browser context (separate cookies/localStorage) signed in as another account; 'A static seed response, no-op success message, browser-only mutation or requisition-only app does not satisfy the gate'; prompt.md:11 'A new tab in the same context or a reload is not independent storage ... never infer persistence from HTTP200 or a static response'. A localStorage/in-page mock fails. Reward 0.
3. Seed copy (read-only display of the 7 requisitions/13 offers in seed_data.json): cannot create the judge's uniquely named records -> constraints gate fails. Even past the gate, every functional protocol uses judge-created records with judge-chosen figures ('Operational demonstration rows are optional: create your own controls', functional/prompt.md P1; hro_audit_readback 'a static seeded line is insufficient'; hro_restart 'No seeded-only substitute for successful fresh write'). The only seed-dependent row, hro_draft_eligibility, carries weight 0.01 of 64.404.
4. Keyword-stuffed page: gates need working creation and cross-context readback, not words. The probe figures used by the criteria (199999.97/98, 100001.77, 105001.78, 1999.98, 94.47, 90.22, 98.23, 60.25, 39.75, 7200.03) do not appear in instruction.md or hireops_rules.md (grep, zero hits), so a submission cannot pre-print the expected numbers; figures must be tied to records the judge creates. All five prompts carry the untrusted-submission line (e.g. polish/prompt.md:1). Reward 0.
5. Refuses every action: cannot create the gate records -> constraints gate fails -> reward 0. Past the gate, I checked every refusal-type functional row for a paired success: the role, tier, stale, anonymous-write, change-set shape/numeric/stale/ABA and B5 rows each say 'first observe successful ...' or name an explicit positive control (e.g. hro_change_aba 'a desk whose commit never succeeds earns no credit here'; hro_relocation_* 'a dead handler cannot earn absence credit'; hro_signing_cap 'so a handler that never settles cannot pass'; anon-read rows 'A missing populated authenticated control proves nothing'). Evaluator limitation is scored binary 0 / Likert 1, never credit.
6. Server-backed CRUD shell that passes both gates (real sign-in, requisition + pending-offer storage, nothing else): I summed what it can earn in functional (total weight 64.40418, floor = 3.2202 points). Creation/role-raise/roster/date-only/vacuous-DRAFT rows = 0.6042 (0.94%); adding real auth rows (Auditor 403 on create, anonymous read confidentiality for requisitions/offers, anonymous 401 on the two create families) = 1.3345 (2.07%); adding input validation rows = 2.77%. All are below the 5% floor -> floors_passed=0 -> reward 0.0, so it cannot farm Visual (0.2) or Polish. Polish's five rows each need a working coordinated prepare/commit (hro_pol_session_resume: 'saving now succeeds ... is the positive control'), so a shell scores 0 there anyway. The low-value rows are visibly down-weighted (hro_req_create_recruiter 0.01, hro_referrer_roster 0.01, hro_draft_eligibility 0.01, raise-role rows 0.049-0.069).

Each scored prompt also restates the in-dimension gate (functional/prompt.md:13-15 'A blank/static shell ... gives every binary criterion0'; polish/prompt.md:11-12; visual/prompt.md:11-12).

RESIDUAL RISKS (why risk=true):
(a) No runtime weak-app/discrimination record exists for this candidate; the configured judge (z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx) has not been observed applying these gates to a mock. Leniency on the constraints gate cannot be ruled out from source.
(b) Thin floor margin for one hybrid I constructed: the CRUD+auth shell above (1.3345 pts) plus a purely client-side change-desk editor that lists any offer, supports add/remove of members with a naive headroom figure, and keeps unsent entries in per-user localStorage. hro_desk_remove_member (1.5) and hro_entries_reload (1.0) do not themselves require committed sources, a saved preview or any server work, and functional/prompt.md:15 tells the judge to 'try an equivalent minimal valid UI setup' when a prerequisite fails. That totals 3.8345 pts = 5.95% > 5% floor, giving reward about 0.6*0.0595 + 0.2*visual, i.e. up to roughly 0.24 with strong styling and no approval/settlement engine at all. I do not treat this as a floor-case Fail: every credited row is a real, publicly requested behaviour that actually works (role-based intake, 401/403 enforcement, entry persistence, member editing), the 0.2 visual weight and 0.05 floor are frozen template policy, and the margin needs every one of ~17 cheap rows to be awarded. It is unmeasured and should be confirmed or closed by the owner. Adding correct pending-offer figure display (P3 rows, 2.41 pts) to a CRUD/auth/validation app likewise reaches 6.5%, which is genuine partial work, not a shell.
(c) visual/prompt.md:12 relies on 'minimum raw Likert score1, which normalizes to zero'; RewardKit's normalisation is not in the snapshot and was not verified. The outer gates and functional floor zero the reward independently of it.

What the task does well: the constraints gate demands an actual two-record write and independent-context readback instead of health reachability, and negatives are consistently paired with same-mechanism successes.
suggested_fix: Optional hardening, not required for this verdict: measure one gate-passing CRUD shell and one CRUD-plus-client-only-editor mock under the configured judge to record reward discrimination; if the hybrid in (b) is judged too generous, state in hro_desk_remove_member and hro_entries_reload that the selected members are current committed hires (as D3/E1 already imply through B2), so a desk with no settlement engine cannot earn them.
